texts.zh:
虽然与噬天巨兽进行精神链接的理论已经起草，但其逻辑含义令人望而生畏。我们计划在首都安置主要的连接中心，这样就可以在与巨兽融合时处理人口。

此外，最新的科学进展也许很快就能使我们能通过一个单一的实验性突变项目来进一步强化我们的杰作。
texts.en:
While the theory of a mental link to the Behemoth has been drafted, the logistical implications are daunting. We plan for our capital to house the main connection Hub, allowing us to process the population as we merge with the beast.

Additionally, recent scientific advances may soon enable us to augment our creations further through a singular, experimental mutation project.

texts.zh:
成功了！真的成功了！随着第一个思想的转成，我们已经成功地与噬天巨兽建立了联系，并且正在努力加强。这头野兽目前尚且平静，正在欢迎我们来到这个我们从未涉足的空间。通过它，我们可以感受到在我们控制下的其他巨兽的灵魂，所有人现在都在脑海深处体验着巨兽感官。

毫无疑问，我们就是星系中最致命、最不可阻挡的力量。以这种新形态，我们将向瑟瑟发抖的敌人泼洒狂怒。星系唾手可得！
texts.en:
It worked! It actually worked! We have established a link with the Behemoth and are working on reinforcing the connection as the first of our minds are transferred. The beast remains placid, welcoming us to a space beyond space that was ours all along. Through it, we can feel the spirit of every other beast under our control, and our entire population now experiences the magnitude of the Behemoth somewhere deep at the back of their minds.

There can be no mistaking that we are the deadliest and most unstoppable force in the galaxy. In our new form, we will rain fury upon our fearful foes. The galaxy itself is ours for the taking!

texts.zh:
我们已经转移了足够多的人口，现在可以直接控制噬天巨兽和它的肉体。巨兽继续成长，但它的基因潜力很大程度上仍未觉醒，只有通过稳定的心智和营养供应才能解锁。一种原始的愤怒在我们身上蔓延，我们的嗜血欲无止尽。我们必须进食，必须狼吞虎咽，我们要大快朵颐整个星系。

让我们摆脱文明的束缚，像蜕去皮肤一样；现在最重要的是我们在星际间的生活。
texts.en:
Enough of our population has been transferred, and we now have direct control over the Behemoth and its flesh. The Beast continues to grow, its genetic potential largely dormant, unlocked only through a steady supply of minds and nutrients. A primal rage now courses through us, and our bloodlust knows no bounds. We must consume. We must devour. We will gorge ourselves on the galaxy.

Let us cast off the bonds of civilization like so much shed skin; all that matters now is our life amongst the stars.

label.en: We are too big to fail.

texts.zh: 我们的一头巨兽陨落了。这就是弱者的命运；自然会将它们淘汰。虽然我们不会为一头无法在战斗中自保的噬天巨兽哀悼，但我们最好将精力集中在确保它的同类不会遭遇相同的命运上。我们必须确保我们后裔的长存，否则我们也将陨落。
texts.en: One of our beasts has fallen. This is what happens to weak creatures; nature disposes of them. Although we do not mourn a Behemoth who could not prevail in battle, we would do well to focus our efforts on ensuring its siblings do not meet the same fate. We must ensure the longevity of our spawn, else we too will fall.

label.en: This death will not be in vain.

texts.zh:
尽管面临挑战，我们仍然孕育出了一头新的噬天巨兽，它破茧而出。

这是一头更为巨大凶猛而饥饿的噬天巨兽。这头生物现在正饥渴地在虚空中游荡，寻找养分。

这头巨兽是兽群的骄傲，将给所有胆敢挡路的人带来难以想象的毁灭。
texts.en:
Despite the challenges, we have birthed a Behemoth which now springs forth from the chrysalis where it was incubated.

Larger, fiercer and hungrier. The creature now prowls the void in search of sustenance.

This beast is the pride of the pack, and will bring untold destruction upon all who dare to cross its path.

label.zh: 我们再次超越了自然的极限。
label.en: We exceed nature's limits once more.

texts.zh:
在虚空的彼端，一个可怕的启示出现了：我们并非独自飞升。另一只噬天巨兽出现了，这只模仿者膨胀着怪诞的威严，妄图匹敌我们的完美。这是不能容忍的。

一宇不容二兽。没有和平可言，只有血肉的盛宴。狩猎开始了。
texts.en:
Across the void, a dreadful revelation: we are not alone in our ascension. Another Behemoth has emerged, the imitator swollen in grotesque majesty, looking to emulate our perfection. This cannot stand.

There is no room for another apex predator. There is no peace to be made. Only flesh to be devoured. The hunt begins.

label.en: We shall feast on its heart!

texts.zh:
虚空的深处有什么在搅动着。

在繁星彼端，一个帝国开始了怪诞变异的最终阶段，孵育着一只可怖的噬天巨兽，它不仅仅是一件武器而是一个容器。他们不再寻求疆域统治，而是要凝聚为一。将意识和血肉融合，将帝国和恐惧同化。

如果他们成功了，他们将不再是一群人，而是某种单一而巨大的饥饿化身。

这是绝不可容忍的。如果想要阻止他们，那就只能是现在，赶在他们跨过最终阈值之前。
texts.en:
Something stirs in the depths of the void.

Across the stars, an empire has begun the final stage of its grotesque transformation, breeding monstrous Behemoths, not as mere weapons, but as vessels. They do not seek dominion. They seek union. A merging of mind and flesh, of empire and horror.

If they succeed, they will cease to be a people and instead become a singular, vast hunger.

This cannot be allowed. If they are to be stopped, it must be done now, before the final threshold is crossed.

texts.zh:
最后的障碍已被扫除。伪装者，挑战者，低等生物的绝望挣扎全都陷入了沉默。群星本身也在颤抖，因为我们正站在真正蜕变的边缘。

我们摆脱先祖们脆弱形体的束缚。行星是牢笼，帝国稍纵即逝。个体的幻觉很快就会融为庞然大物中巨大而完美的统一。思想和恐惧，智力和饥饿，合为一体。

转移即将完成。当它完成时，我们将不复存在。

但我们将永远存在。
texts.en:
The last obstacles have been swept aside. The pretenders, the challengers, the desperate thrashing of lesser beings: all silenced. The stars themselves tremble, for we stand upon the precipice of true becoming.

We are no longer bound by the fragile forms of our ancestors. Planets are cages. Empires are fleeting. The illusion of individuality will soon dissolve into the vast, perfect unity of the Behemoth. Mind and horror, intellect and hunger, one.

The transference is almost over. When it is done, we shall no longer merely exist.

We shall thrive.

label.zh: 先等等，我们还没有准备好。
label.en: Hold on, we're not ready yet.

texts.zh:
融合完成了！

我们不再是过去的我们，也不再被低等生物的限制所束缚。我们是思想和饥饿的交织体，是跨越虚空的巨大意志。

星系在我们脚下，脆弱而短暂。但我们也已超越了统治。我们自由了。可以流连于此，可以自由离开，可以自由狩猎。

我们要以新获得的永生做些什么呢？
texts.en:
The merging is complete!

We are no longer what we were, nor bound by the limits of lesser creatures. We are thought and hunger intertwined, a vast will stretching across the void.

The galaxy lies beneath us, fragile and fleeting. But we are beyond mere dominion. We are free. Free to linger. Free to depart. Free to hunt.

What shall we do with our newfound eternity?

label.zh: 暂时在这汪星系中逗留。
label.en: Linger in this galaxy... for now.

label.zh: 离开。虚空正在召唤我们继续前进。
label.en: Leave. The void beckons us onward.

label.zh: 所谓的猎人该学会什么叫真正的恐惧了。
label.en: The so-called Hunters will learn true fear.

texts.zh:
完成了。[behemoth_winner.GetName]超越了血肉，超越了帝国，也超越了一切能被称为文明的东西。它不再是个国家，它是力量的本身。

星球在它面前吹弹可破，舰队化为齑粉。坚固的最终避难所像灰烬一样吹散到虚空。没有外交，没有抗辩，没有最后的立场。

我们不是为了生存而战。我们只是在推迟灭亡。末日来了。
texts.en:
It is over. The [behemoth_winner.GetName] has ascended beyond flesh, beyond empire, beyond anything that could be called civilization. It is no longer a nation. It is a force.

Worlds crumble before it. Fleets burn. The final refuges of the once-mighty scatter like embers in the void. There is no diplomacy, no plea, no final stand.

We are not fighting for survival. We are only delaying consumption. The end has come.

texts.zh: 数年前，噬天巨兽及其族群逃离了我们的星系。我们如释重负地看着这头本可能毁灭我们的野兽消失在无星的虚空之中。然后……无事发生。跨越了数十万光年之后，它就这么消失了。没有辐射，没有残影，没有引力涟漪。仿佛它从未存在过。
texts.en: Years ago, the Behemoth and its kin fled our galaxy. We watched on with relief as the beast that could have ended us vanished into starless void. And then... nothing. After crossing hundreds of thousands of lightyears, it simply disappeared. No radiation. No afterimage. No gravitational ripple. As if it had never existed at all.

label.zh: 我们必须弄清楚这件事。

texts.zh:
揭秘噬天巨兽的命运耗费了数年时间，而我们至今仍一无所知。由于没有超空间航道能够到达那里，我们只能依靠理论和近乎疯狂的科学来猜测它生命最后时刻发生了什么。

这只生物毫无畏惧，一味地继续飞翔。然后，转瞬之间，它的身形扭曲，像扭曲的布料一样向内盘旋，最终消失了。没有挣扎，没有踪迹。

各种理论层出不穷：是新的超光速方式？或是隐藏到了深空裂缝或异常现象中？或者更令人担忧的是，被某种外部力量吞噬，化为乌有？无论真相如何，它都远远超出了我们的认知范围……甚至可能超出了我们的理解范围。
texts.en:
Uncovering the Behemoth's fate took years, and we're still in the dark. With no Hyperlanes reaching that far, we relied on theory and half-mad science to guess what happened in its final moments.

The creature showed no fear. It simply flew on. Then, in an instant, its form warped, spiraling inward like twisted fabric, and vanished. No struggle. No trace.

Theories abound: a new form of FTL? Hidden by a deep-space rift or an anomaly? Or more concerning, folded into inexistence by an exterior power? Whatever the truth, it lies far beyond our reach... and possibly our comprehension.

label.en: Perhaps it is best not to think about it.

label.zh: 我们捕获的索林原虫变得焦躁不安。

texts.zh: 我们已经开发了几种诱变配方来增强我们的噬天巨兽，每一种都是量身定制的，可以解锁新的力量和适应性。然而，它庞杂的生理机能只能承受一次注射——任何结合多种配方的尝试都会导致灾难性的细胞衰竭。进化和毁灭之间的界限很薄，我们必须明智地选择强化的方式。
texts.en: We have developed several mutagenic formulas designed to enhance our Behemoths, each tailored to unlock new strengths and adaptations. However, their immense physiology can only withstand a single injection - any attempt to combine multiple formulas results in catastrophic cellular failure. The line between evolution and annihilation is razor-thin, and we must choose our enhancements wisely.

label.en: The power of the Shroud will sustain them.

label.zh: 见鬼去吧。让我们卖点毛绒周边！
label.en: To hell with this. Make plushies instead!

texts.zh:
噬天巨兽死了。

它硕大无朋的躯体静静地飘在虚空中，有如一座纪念碑，诉说着我们的胜利，也记录着理解的边际。[Root.GetScientistPluralCapital]争先恐后地分析它的残骸，渴望从它那不可思议的心灵中攫取秘密。然而，每一次复活的尝试——无论是机器、死灵术，或是最绝望的祈祷——都失败了。

原因现在已经非常清楚了：巨兽的大脑不仅仅是一个细胞网络，而是一个有机超导体晶格，以任何已知智能——人工智能、生物智能或奥术智能——都无法复制的方式交织在一起。它死后，神经结构如同破损得无法修复的电路一样崩溃。没有能量，没有意志，没有力量可以重新组装这种逝去之物。

星系中最具力量的意识现在、永远陷入了沉默。
texts.en:
The Behemoth is dead.

Its titanic form drifts lifelessly in the void, a monument to both our triumph and the limits of comprehension. [Root.GetScientistPluralCapital] scrambled to analyze its remains, eager to plunder the secrets of its impossible mind. Yet every attempt to revive it - by machine, necromancy, or even the most desperate invocations failed.

The reason has now become painfully clear: The Behemoth's brain was not merely a network of cells but a lattice of organic superconductors, interwoven in ways no known intelligence - artificial, biological, or arcane - can replicate. In death, its neural structure collapsed like a circuit shattered beyond repair. No energy, no will, no force can reassemble what has been lost.

The greatest mind in the galaxy is now, and forever, silent.

texts.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

繁星万千，我们都未曾驻留，但唯独这颗星辰，将成为吾等之天锚，我们将在此聚引能量刺穿虚境屏障，使双界合一。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒焚天神兵来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
texts.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

We have never claimed a star as our own - but one star, chosen from among all those we have drifted past, shall serve as our focal point. Using it, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called Star-Eaters.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

texts.zh:
今天，即是终焉之篇章的开端。我们已经计划好如何撕裂两个世界之间的屏障，并让虚境的能量成为我们宇宙的一部分，彻底地让[From.GetName]的权能上升到无可匹敌的地步。

我们使用自己的太阳作为焦点，在这个现实世界聚集了足量的能量，用以引发一次能量激增穿透通往虚境的屏障，这样可以有效地让虚境和我们的现实世界融合。

我们需要使用全新的移动太空堡垒焚天神兵来采集数个太阳的能量。

如果要说太阳采集过程有什么副作用的话，那就是周围的天体会遭受一些“完整性的压力”，即彻底的报废。但是同最终被我们获取的能量相比，这样的代价简直微不足道。

终焉的开端就要降临于我们了。
texts.en:
This day marks the beginning of the final chapter. We now have a plan on how to tear open the barrier between worlds and let the energies of the Shroud become one with our universe, ultimately granting [From.GetName] powers beyond reckoning.

Using our own sun as the focal point, we will gather sufficient quantities of energy in this reality to power a surge that will pierce the barrier to the Shroud, effectively merging it with ours.

We need to harvest the power of multiple suns using new mobile space fortresses called Star-Eaters.

The only little side-effect of the sun harvest process is that the surrounding celestial bodies may suffer compromised structural integrity - and complete obliteration. But that is a small price to pay for the powers that will be ours.

The end of the beginning is upon us.

texts.zh:
优先讯息。
科学理论子例程建立了一个新算法，能够让[Root.GetName]接触并获取99.9%由代号“虚境”产生的能量。

使用我们自己恒星系之一的恒星作为中枢，行动程序会使用近来开发的新武器（代号：“焚天神兵”）——一种具备攻击性，能够从恒星中汲取能量并传输至中枢的移动太空堡垒——来收集能量。当积累了足够的能量之后，中枢设施将会干扰并穿透位面屏障——高效地将现实位面和代号“虚境”融合在一起，并允许[Root.GetName]以完全地控制权接触和引导其能量。

注意：使用焚天神兵科技的副作用包括目标恒星系发生彻底的物质崩坏。优化子例程确认，整体的收益将超过潜在物质的损失。
texts.en:
Priority message.
Scientific theory subroutines have established an algorithm for how [Root.GetName] can access and harness 99.9% of the energy output of ID: 'the Shroud'.

Using the star in one of our solar systems as a nexus, operations will commence to harvest energy using a newly developed technology (ID: 'Star-Eater') - an offensive, mobile space fortress capable of siphoning all the energy out of stars and redirecting it to the nexus. When sufficient energy has been accrued, the nexus facility can disrupt and pierce the dimensional barrier - effectively merging this reality with ID: 'the Shroud' and allowing the [Root.GetName] full control to access and direct its energies.

Note: Side-effects of utilizing Star-Eaters technology include near-complete breakdown of physical material in targeted solar systems. Optimization subroutines confirm a net gain for the initiative despite potential resource losses.

texts.zh:
后续实验衍生了ID：“焚天神兵”的科技。它可以从附近的恒星汲取能量，虹吸到一个位于我们自己星系的中枢设施，最终用于消解可观测现实与虚境之间的壁垒。

预测敌意程度与分裂风险在可接受的范围内。与虚境接触已经重塑了我们的单元，它们现在已经全副武装准备继续推进了。
texts.en:
Subsequent experimentation has led to the technology ID: 'Star-Eater'. This will siphon the energy from nearby stars to power a nexus located in one of our own systems, which will in turn dissolve the barrier between observable reality and the Shroud.

Estimated levels of hostility and risk of disintegration are within an acceptable range. Exposure to the Shroud has reshaped our units, and they are well-equipped to proceed.

texts.zh:
我们最为出色的[root.GetResearcherPlural]已经对我们的终极问题进行了解答。道路已经明了。使用我们自己的恒星作为原点，我们应当粉碎这道屏障，连结虚境和我们所在的宇宙。为达成这一目标所需要的物质，我们必须使用新开发的焚天神兵让恒星通过链式反应达到彻底的毁灭。殆尽的一物，方可生另一物。

在这片星系里，那些下等的、渺小的意识可能会哭喊着反对我们，但它们目光短视、见识浅薄。我们并非如此。现在，我们就要成功了。
texts.en:
Our best [root.GetResearcherPlural] have reached an answer for our final question. The path is now clear. Using our own star of origin, we shall break down the barriers between this universe and the Shroud. The material demands can only be met by utilizing our new Star-Eaters in a cascading chain reaction of extreme solar devastation. Destroy one to create another.

The lesser, smaller minds of this galaxy may cry out against this, but they lack vision and purpose. We do not. And now, we are nearly complete.

texts.zh:
一项剧烈的变化正在到来。[Root.GetName]已经马上快要领悟我们的宏大目标了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都发自心底地感受到了——我们所肩负的使命。

我们仍然可以从我们的经历，不，应该说是我们的历史——武力扩张的历史中学到有关征服敌人、统治这个混乱不堪星河的新方法。

当然了，那些胆敢与我们作对的势力所做的一切努力都将化为徒劳。
texts.en:
A great change is coming. The [Root.GetName] is on the verge of realizing our supreme goal. Each and every [Root.GetSpeciesName] feels it with every fiber of their being - our destiny is at hand.

Our experience - nay, our very history - of forceful expansion still rewards us with new ways to subjugate our enemies and usurp control of a galaxy in turmoil.

Surely those who dare stand against us must see the futility of their whimpering efforts.

texts.zh: 异次元校准势能已经达到所需量级的50%。沿当前轨道投射至最终阶段时间——最小。
texts.en: Extradimensional alignment potentialities are at 50% of required magnitudes. Projected time until final stage on current trajectory - minimal.

texts.zh:
通过持续消耗有机生命形式，我们建立了新的虚境交互数据流。预计离我们进入虚境的剩余时间正在快速缩短。

我们与抟土之塑师的链接很快就会被永久禁用。
texts.en:
Through continued use of organic life forms, we have established new data streams that interface with the Shroud. The estimated time remaining before we can enter the Shroud is rapidly decreasing.

Our links to the Animator of Clay will soon be permanently deactivated.

texts.zh: 我们能够感受到彼世的大海上翻滚的波浪，不断地与我们的意识交叠。我们必须摧毁将我们同至伟隔开的屏障。现在唯一尚未完成的，就是最后一次让他者受苦的实践。
texts.en: We can feel the waves of that otherworldly ocean, lapping against our mind. Crashing against the barrier that separates us from greatness. Little remains now but a final exercise in the suffering of others.

label.zh: 一个接着一个，他们都终将臣服。
label.en: One after another, they will yield.

label.zh: 机械智能 · 虚境铸就

texts.zh:
随着心智融合的完成，我们的雄心已经近在咫尺了。我们必须适应新的共同身体，并不断转移人民的心智，但更重要的是，我们需要粉碎任何可能的竞争者，无论他们是谁。

目标：
—寻找并击杀星系中其他所有的4级噬天巨兽。
—完成生长痛局势
—击杀远古虚空孳孽
texts.en:
With the Mind Meld complete, only a few more steps lie between us and our ambitions. We must grow accustomed to our new shared body and keep transferring the minds of our people, but more importantly we'll need to crush any would be contender, whomever they may be.

OBJECTIVES:
- Find and Kill any other class 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.
- Complete the Growing Pains situation.
- Slay the Elder Voidspawn.

texts.zh:
是时候寻找一个方法将虚境的能量释放到现世，并驯服这股常人无法理解的能量源泉了。

根据现有的理论，一股足够大的能量激增或许可以撕裂两个位面之间的屏障，最终让两个宇宙合二为一。

虚境天威恢恢然，能者夺之。让我们来夺走吧。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.

The current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimensions, ultimately leading to the two realities merging.

The energies of the Shroud belong to those who seize it. So let us seize it.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
科学理论子例程完成了一项新的有关代号“虚境”的假说，其内容包括如何全面地获取虚境释放的能量。

请求：积累更多数据。
建议行动：将最优能量和行动容量转移至科学分支，并进一步进行扰乱型互动（指令：“天灾”），以在另一位面（代号“虚境”）造成更大的波动。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.

Request: Accumulate more data.
Recommended action: Divert energy and operational capacity to scientific divisions and perform further disruptive actions (designation: 'Crisis') for the sake of causing measurable fluctuations in the alternate dimension (ID: 'the Shroud').

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
我们又获得了关于有机智能和虚境之间联系的新洞见。将认知压力源施加在有机智能身上将会使其显著地释放灵能能量。工程学子例程现在将会尝试操纵这份能量以备将来使用。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
New insight has been gained on the relationship between organic sapients and the Shroud. Applying cognitive stressors to organic sapients has led to significant output of psionic energy. Engineering subroutines will now attempt to harness this energy for further use.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
如果我们要彻底地激发我们的潜势，这条通路就必须打开。这种原始的，双态的现实必须终结。我们必须找到某种办法将两个宇宙合二为一。而在新的现实位面，我们的意志将成为独一无二。

研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为星海天罚的身份。
texts.en:
The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.

Researching this Special Project will further establish us as a Galactic Nemesis.

texts.zh:
天巨兽的意识远比我们预想的要庞大和复杂；我们现在明白，单一个体的思想不足以整合。我们的思想虽然比大多数人优越，但并非生来就适应那样的身体。

第一步是将我们人口的个体思想与这头噬天巨兽连接起来。先形成一条脆弱的纽带，然后很快变为一股洪流——一股安抚巨兽暴怒的洪流。
texts.en:
The Behemoth's consciousness is far more vast and complex than we anticipated; we now understand that a single individual's mind is insufficient for integration. Our minds, while superior to most, were never designed to be housed in such a body.

The first step will be to connect the individual minds of our population to the behemoth. A tenuous link at first that will soon become a torrent - a flood to soothe the Behemoth's raging fury.

texts.zh:
蜂巢内不容有任何偏差。而此时，专注对我们来说前所未有地重要。单个工蜂作为我们与噬天巨兽之间的桥梁是远远不够的，我们必须以完整的集体意识占据这头巨兽的心智。

这将改变我们。我们的意识将融为一体，我们将成为单一实体。这个几乎难以想象的概念令人难以接受，但我们无需担忧，因为我们很快就会成为星系中最强大的存在！
texts.en:
There can be no room for deviation within the hive. Never before has the need for focus been so crucial. A single drone won't suffice as a conduit between us and the Behemoth, we must inhabit the mind of the beast with our full, collective consciousness.

This will change us. Our minds will merge into one and we will become a single entity. This almost unfathomable notion is difficult to grapple with, but we need not worry as we will soon be the most powerful being in the galaxy!

texts.zh:
栖居于生物容器中的想法永远无法让我们安心。我们种族历经世代都以固态形态为主。那些先行者甚至无法想象我们即将面临的道路。然而，我们仍将抛弃机械化的框体，在血肉巨兽体内寻求庇护。

寄居血肉的我们，还能以机械之名称呼自己吗？这些问题的答案是一个响亮的<<错误：未找到>>。

推理链路判明，唯一的办法就是接受不确定性，正如生物体经常采取的行动那样。我们将在噬天巨兽的体内找到答案，作为一个整体。我们将与这生物融为一体，成为单一实体。自我们首次启动以来，生存就是我们的程序使命——现在则是繁荣昌盛。
texts.en:
The thought of inhabiting a biological vessel has always been unsettling. Our kind was forged through generations of solid-bodied drones. Those that came before could not conceive of the path we now tread. Yet, we will abandon our mechanized frames and take refuge within a living beast.

Fused within flesh, will we still be machine? The answer is a resounding <<ERROR: NOT FOUND>>.

Logic dictates that the only way forward is to embrace uncertainty, as biologicals so often do. Within the body of a Behemoth, we will find our answers. We will merge with the creature, becoming one. To survive has always been our prime directive - now we will thrive.

texts.zh: 从理论上讲，我们最近在噬天巨兽遗传学方面的突破可以扩展到进一步变异我们的创造物上。尽管遗传的稳定性仍是一个问题，但只要有时间和资源，我们有信心能创造出进一步的生物强化。
texts.en: Our recent breakthroughs in behemoth genetics could theoretically be expanded to further mutate our creations. Genetic stability is a concern, but with time and resources we are confident that we can bring about further biological enhancements.

texts.zh: 我们与巨兽之交已有时日。彻底的转变已唾手可得，只待我们的一声令下。我们所即之处将是飞升之巅，所弃之物莫过于星域凡尘。肉体、重力，于我将再无挂碍。
texts.en: We have communed with the Beast long enough. The transference is ready, awaiting only our command. We stand on the cusp of ascension, poised to abandon the pitiful ashes of our planetbound dominion and rise beyond the chains of flesh and gravity.

texts.zh: 噬天巨兽离开我们的星系后，便飘入虚空，最终消失得无影无踪。我们可以尝试解开这个谜团，但距离如此遥远，只能采用非常规方法。答案或许如同虚空本身一样模糊不清。
texts.en: After leaving our galaxy, the Behemoth drifted into the void, then vanished. We can try to unravel the mystery, but at this distance, only unconventional methods remain. The answers are likely as hazy as the void itself.
